gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Ruler-straight and unhurried: Bruno Ace lays its letters out one beat at a time, each counter left open to the outside. Bruno Ace makes statements; Zen Kaku Gothic New carries the words.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Bruno Ace draws with a ruler, one unhurried beat per character. Zen Maru Gothic follows in sans-serif, a single thread that never snags, so the heading's pacing hands off smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans keeps the tails of its curves held well back from the body, quiet and modern. But Bruno Ace SC is the show-off, spaced like beads on a thread, and Alan Sans does the carrying.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads smoothly, its brush-like ends lifting away before curves close, a quiet partner for Bruno Ace SC. Whole paragraphs would glide along without catching on a single curve.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-assistant: Assistant is a sans whose mouths stay open on its round letters, a level-headed foil for Bruno Ace SC. Bruno Ace SC earns its keep in big, short bursts.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-asta-sans: Bruno Ace SC spaces its letters like beads on a long thread. Asta Sans draws tubelike, constant lines with open e shapes, so page after page of text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree keeps its round letters light and unpinched, with no swelling and thinning anywhere. Bruno Ace SC stretches out beside it like beads on a thread, so the two feel relaxed together.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-barlow: Open and spaced out, Bruno Ace SC strings its letters like beads, while Barlow pulls its c tips well apart. Both keep their strokes constant, with no thinning to speak of.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic spaces lavishly, with clear channels into round letters. Bruno Ace SC matches that openness with rounds and stems in a single weight, and that shared spaciousness is the draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cairo: Cairo is a modern sans with a wide channel into every bowl. Bruno Ace SC is best at showing off, its strokes fixed from stem to curve, while Cairo is best at carrying text.
